items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
items.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

items.title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Outlook mobile apps
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

items.title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook mobile apps
items.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on mobile devices.

items.title: Outlook: Manage Multiple Inbox Rules at Once
items.description: You will soon be able to manage multiple inbox rules at the same time. Select every rule or choose only the ones you want to update. You can then delete, enable, or disable the selected rules in one action. This makes it faster and easier to keep your rules organized. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): People Skills- removal and deletion admin control
items.description:
A new admin control in the People Skills settings lets administrators permanently remove their organization's People Skills data from the tenant. With this new control, organizations can delete their entire skills library along with all users confirmed, inferred, and imported skills data—giving them full control to offboard from People Skills in support of data governance and compliance needs.
Once deletion is initiated, skills will no longer appear on user profile cards or be used across Micros

items.title: Universal Print: Universal Print Portal
items.description: You can release your secure print jobs by scanning a QR code at any printer and access your print workflows from a browser on any device, all signed in with your Microsoft 365 account.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced bookable desk experience with Teams panel-based desk dock devices
items.description: Users have better experiences in flexible work environments with Microsoft Teams panel-based desk dock devices coming later this year. The Teams panel app now enables devices, such as the Yealink Linkhub, to enhance bookable desk experiences by indicating at-a-glance availability and letting visitors book directly on the device. Each device requires a Teams Shared Space license.

items.title: Planner: Microsoft Planner tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
items.description: Digital signage can now be displayed on idle Teams panel devices, similar to digital signage support for Microsoft Teams Rooms front of room displays. Signage source and settings can be configured in the Pro Management portal. Available with Teams Rooms Pro or Shared space-licensed spaces.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
items.description: Speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by launching Data Security Investigations (DSI) from endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alerts. In DSI, define your endpoint DLP query (for example, time range, users, and endpoints). DSI then automatically gathers the related files that triggered the alerts for review (for example, UserA downloaded a file on 3/1/2026).

items.title: Planner: Custom Templates
items.description: Custom templates let you create reusable, pre-designed layouts tailored to your organization’s needs, ensuring consistency and saving time. They provide flexibility to standardize content while allowing easy customization for specific scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices
items.description: Organizational Messages now supports Hybrid-joined Devices.
